messages:
incident-bot: Pager opened: INC-2891234567 — Severity: 2. Metric: embedding latency P95>1.2s in eu-west-1; error rate ~8% for batched jobs. Oncall: @sam.

sam: got the page, looking now. spinning up extra workers and routing fallback to small-embed model.

maria: any customer-facing impact? do we need to notify CS?

sam: yes — 2 customers reported timeouts for large-batch embeddings; non-blocking but elevated error rate. CS notified via ticket 78912.

jordan: can you dump recent logs + sample request IDs so we can see if it's payload size or KV pressure?

sam: dumping keys now. seeing KV cache thrash around 14:20, memory churn on embedder pod group. attaching short log:```
E 14:21:02 embedder/worker.go:214 kvcache evict loop took 420ms
W 14:21:03 server/handler.go:87 request timeout (batch size=512, seq=2048)
```

eli: sounds like prefix cache eviction + big batch payloads. immediate mitigation: cap batch_size to 256, enable KV eviction guard on embedder group, and promote fallback routing. can someone make a quick PR to pin batch defaults?

maria: @sam can you run cap now? we need minimal risk rollback plan.

sam: capping batch_size -> 256 in prod config (temporary). monitoring.

incident-bot: Status update: mitigated (traffic routing + batch cap). Error rate down to ~1.1% after 10m.

jordan: ok mitigation worked. post-incident next steps: schedule postmortem, capture root cause (KV eviction under high batch sizes), create remediation tickets for durable KV sizing + autoscaling policy.

eli: propose action items: [A1] KV capacity increase + evict-policy tuning (owner: jordan) — estimate: 3d (medium). [A2] Backpressure: server-side batch rejection for extreme batch sizes (owner: sam) — estimate: 2d (small). [A3] Rollout guard: failover routing by model-variant when embedder lat < 800ms (owner: maria) — estimate: 5d (large).

maria: +1 on items. Also tie A3 to Q2 objective: "Reduce embedding tail latency" (OKR-E-2).

jordan: created tickets: https://issues.redwood.ai/ISSUE-4567 (KV-cap), ISSUE-4568 (backpressure), ISSUE-4569 (routing guard). linked INC-2891234567.

sam: assigning myself to ISSUE-4568, will make PR for batch default rollback and add tests. ETA: EOD + 1 (approx 2 days to full fix).

eli: prioritization: A1 (medium, sev2) -> P0 for next sprint; A2 (small) -> P0 hotfix branch; A3 (large) -> P1 for sprint planning but tie to Q2 roadmap.

maria: availability for postmortem: Mon 09:30 or Tue 14:00. prefer Mon.

jordan: I'll draft the postmortem template and share in #incidents for review. include timeline, mitigation, impact numbers, owner list, and action items with estimates.

support-bot: CS update: two customers impacted, one requested credits; CS will not issue credits until postmortem is published.

sam: note for remediation tickets: include perf test that simulates batch=512 and warmed KV cold-start. we saw relaunch cold impact after scale events.

eli: agreed. capture acceptance criteria on each ticket: KV-cap should show <0.5% errors at 512 batch in staging; backpressure should return 429 for >512 within 95th percentile latency target; routing guard should failover to small model with <200ms added latency.

maria: can we add an evaluation check in Redwood Optimize to flag high batch-size jobs? filing follow-up ISSUE-4570 (owner: maria) estimate: 3d.

jordan: timeline summary: hotfix (A2) -> deploy in 24h; KV-cap (A1) -> sprint+3d dev; routing guard (A3) -> next sprint planning, Q2 tie-in. postmortem meeting Monday 09:30. I will move tickets to "remediation backlog" and tag q2-roadmap where appropriate.

sam: thanks everyone. closing page now but keeping thread open for asynchronous updates. :thumbsup:
